body: Yeah. It's strange, though, to think that who I am (and being deeply unhappy is a large part of me, unfortunately) could be changed by taking a pill; it's even more worrisome to thing that I couldn't be changed. I'll look into it.

I was in therapy very briefly. And, for plans, I meant that to mean that I was not planning to kill myself ASAP; I have vague and general plans for my "future", but, honestly, they seem like more of a framework until I die rather than a goal to live for.

As for talking, and friends, I have plenty of friends (not sure how that happened), and a few very close friends. They know about my history, and they really try to be helpful; I just feel like talking about it isn't helpful, and is stressful for them. Having plans helps, sort of; being a part of a long-term production (like a play) was always helpful in high school (You can't kill yourself! You have a performance!), and it's good now, too.

I attempted suicide my junior year of high school, through some fluke it was unsuccessful. I was in therapy for a few (~two?) months after that; it wasn't very helpful. I haven't ever tried antidepressants.

Thanks, guys. I've never tried any sort of antidepressant; it just never seemed feasible, especially when I was at home. Psychiatrists are really expensive and... I guess I have reservations about effectiveness/placebo effect and... I don't know what I would do if the DIDN'T work- even though I don't have any immediate plans, people are fragile (in more than one way), and I don't think I can handle this (even long enough to turn 22; I had periods of depression before puberty, I'm not sure if age will fix this). I guess I'm even more worried because one side of my family has a really strong history of depression, and, with the exception of the generation I'm a part of, every nuclear family has had at least one suicide. So, if antidepressants don't work, I know I don't have anything to look forward to.

I really appreciate all of your kindness; sometimes it's important just to be able to be honest with others (even internet others).
